endpoints:
  - name: docker01
    group: swarm
    url: "icmp://192.168.1.41"
    interval: 60s
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions: ["[CONNECTED] == true"]

  - name: docker02
    group: swarm
    url: "icmp://192.168.1.42"
    interval: 60s
    ui:
      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions: ["[CONNECTED] == true"]

    ui:

      - "[STATUS] == 200"
      - "has([BODY].Version) == true"

    group: swarm

      resolve-successful-conditions: true
    conditions:

      - "[BODY] == OK"
